name: python-cloud-arc
description: ArcForge Python CloudArc — copy this folder to start a Python serverless backend

scripts.dev: docker compose up -d && npm run dev:api
scripts.install:cdk: cd cdk && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.synth:dev: npm run build:layer && cd cdk && ./scripts/deploy.sh dev synth
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build:layer && cd cdk && ./scripts/deploy.sh dev deploy
